name: io.github.paulwxnter/mcp
description: Open-source Google Maps Platform alternative for agents: search, route, map, geocode, and compute.
title: EmbedEarth (E2)

environmentVariables.name: E2_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional EmbedEarth API key from embed.earth. Raises Cloud Search, Compute, and Route limits from 60 to 2,000 requests per minute and is required for street-level imagery.

environmentVariables.name: ROUTE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional URL of a custom routing service compatible with the E2 route API. Defaults to the first-party routing endpoint.
